overview: The Medford School Committee recognized fall student-athletes and outgoing committee members, received an update on the McGlynn and Andrews HVAC project, and approved the fiscal year 2027 capital plan.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Orchestra Presentation
items.summary: The Medford High School Orchestra gave a musical presentation, and senior and junior students shared their experiences in the program.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Fall Athletics Recognition
items.summary: The committee recognized GBL champions and GBL All-Stars from the fall sports season, including soccer, golf, crew, cheer, cross country, football, and volleyball.

items.title: Special Recognition of Outgoing School Committee Members
items.summary: The committee honored outgoing school committee members Nicole Branley and John Intoppa for their service and dedication to the school district.

items.title: McGlynn and Andrews HVAC Roof Project Update
items.summary: Representatives presented an update on the McGlynn and Andrews schools HVAC roof project, noting that it is currently trending under the approved budget and is on track for completion next spring.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payrolls, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and past meeting minutes.

items.title: FY 2027 Capital Plan Approval
items.summary: Approved the strategic and capital planning subcommittee's near-range capital plan requesting $2 million in funding for fiscal year 2027 priority projects.

items.title: MCHSBC Resignation and Appointment
items.summary: Approved a resolution accepting the resignation of Tracy Keene from the Medford Community High School Building Committee and appointing Paul Malone to fill the vacancy.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Input
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting outgoing members Nicole Branley and John Intoppa to submit their evaluation feedback for the interim superintendent by December 31, 2025.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences on the passing of retired science teacher Francis R. Cangiano and student parent Julie McDonald-Matterese.
